citation.journal: International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer

PDF p. 4: Table 1 and experimental geometry

model_forms_notes: Eq. (24) provides Nu_fc for the empirical model. Eq. (30) provides the reciprocal 1/Nu_nc, not Nu_nc.
Nu_mixed=quadrature combination in Section 3.4, not linear addition.
Properties subscript av are temperature-integral averages from Tb to inner wall Ti; units of the underlying property cancel in ratios.

Dimensionless Q_b=beta_b*q*D/k_b; Gr_q = g*beta_b*q*D**4/(nu_b**2*k_b), nu_b=mu_b/rho_b. beta_b is defined in original nomenclature using rho_b, rho_av and Ti-Tb; preserve exact source definitions before coding.
Do not treat wall-property-conditioned model as fully independent a-priori HTC prediction if Ti is measured.
explicit_limits: These numbers are ORIGINAL-PAPER claims, not reproduced against Stuttgart.
The uploaded source PDF is used only for verification; do not redistribute copyrighted article.
H1a/H1b/H1c benchmarks are on Stuttgart data; original Kim 2019 model has not yet been implemented or tested in this branch.
Original source includes measured-wall / property-dependent formulas; independent predictive validation must avoid measured-target leakage.
The fit originally uses mixed POSTECH and Adebiyi-Hall data; exact independence/training distinctions are not proven by copying Table 6.
Model validity should not be extrapolated to PCHE, Brayton cycles, high-temperature heaters, or other geometries without data.
